game_title: Guess Until Right – Whispering Corridor Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the mine cart using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Whispering Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Whispering Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 22.
